# Nour Aldeen Tofi

> AI Automation Engineer — n8n, LLM Agents, MCP · Frontend Developer — based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. I turn messy manual processes into self-running workflows — and build the interfaces people use on top of them.

Also known as: Nour Aldeen Tofi · Nouraldeen Tofi · Nour Al-Deen Tofi · Nour Aldeen Toufi · Nour Tofi · nouraldeentofi · nourtofi · نور الدين طفي · نور الدين توفي · نور طفي · نور توفي

I build AI automation systems that turn messy manual processes into clean, self-running workflows — and the interfaces people use on top of them. My spearhead is n8n paired with language models: production workflows that read Arabic and English documents, validate them, catch what does not belong, and push clean structured data into sheets, CRMs, and dashboards. By day I lead frontend development as a Software Engineering Supervisor, with a track record of owning delivery end to end — requirements, tasks, production.

## Projects

- [Smart Scanner](https://receipt.nexleadtech.com) (2026): Arabic-first AI invoice management — from photo to approval, with zero manual data entry.
- [CV Screener](https://cv-screener.nouraldeentofi.com) (2026): Upload a folder of CVs — every one is read, classified, and scored by AI, with each point traced to a quote from the CV.
- Universal Web Scraper (2026): One link in, the whole site out — every page discovered, the data classified, and an Excel file with a tab for each kind of data.
- DFS Dashboard (2025–2026): A unified CRM and quotation platform that replaced scattered manual processes across every department.
- [GoldenTag](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.leadbridge.golden_tag) (2025): A jewelry store management app shipped to the Google Play Store.
- Business Card Extractor (2026): Photograph a business card, and it lands in your phone's contacts in one tap.
- MCP Search Server (2026): A Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI model query real data instead of only generating text.

## Automation systems

- Universal Web Scraper (2026, Live): One link in, the whole site out. A shared engine fetches pages and escalates only as far as it must, reads structured data before it spends anything on AI, and writes the rows into a spreadsheet — with quick jobs and long crawls run as separate, controllable workers.
- CV Screener agents (2026, Live): The AI engine of CV Screener: sibling agents that profile one CV, screen one CV against a job, and summarise a whole pool. The product server calls them; every one checks a secret first, fences the CV as data, and returns typed JSON or a typed error.
- Teacher Assistant AI Bot (2025 — present, Running for a client): A natural-language Arabic assistant delivered to a private tutor in Saudi Arabia. The tutor manages students, schedules, cancellations, and dues entirely through chat — the AI agent calls custom CRUD tools under strict business rules rather than guessing.
- Smart Scanner Extraction Pipeline (2026, Live): The production pipeline behind Smart Scanner. Every invoice — photo or PDF — is verified as a real invoice, parsed with GPT-4.1 Vision, validated, deduplicated, and persisted. It reads Arabic, English, and mixed documents, and is tuned for handwritten Arabic invoices and Saudi e-invoice fields.
- Telegram Publishing System (2026, Built and tested): Plan, review, approve and publish posts to LinkedIn, Instagram and Reddit from a Telegram chat. The AI only understands what you meant; every decision after that is made by a deterministic state machine.
- Unified Inbox (2026, Built and tested): Messages from every channel land in one inbox. Each one is enriched with its dialect, intent, priority and a summary, plus a draft reply written in the sender's own dialect — and replies leave through an outbox that records every result.
- Google Review Reply Manager (2026, Built and tested): New Google reviews are picked up on a schedule and answered in the reviewer's own language. Happy reviews get a reply on their own; unhappy ones go to the owner on Telegram, who approves or skips with one tap.
- AI Job-Match Pipeline (2026, Live): A scheduled pipeline that runs five daily search queries across LinkedIn, Indeed, and Glassdoor, scores each role's fit from one to ten with a structured-JSON LLM evaluator, and delivers only the high scorers.
- Transfer Receipt Check (2026, Running for a client): Behind a chess club's tournament registration: the uploaded bank-transfer receipt is read by a vision model, which also says whether it is a transfer at all. The site applies the rules; the workflow only reads.
- WhatsApp Booking Bot (2026, Built and tested): A customer taps a service, then a time slot, in WhatsApp buttons. The confirmed slot is written to Google Calendar and confirmed back on WhatsApp.
- WhatsApp Group from a Spreadsheet (2026, Built and tested): Upload an Excel or CSV of contacts and a group name: the group is created, everyone is added in throttled batches, and anyone WhatsApp refuses to add receives the invite link instead.
- Social Auto-Publisher (2026, Built and tested): Send a post idea to a Telegram bot and get back captions for each platform and a branded image in your own colours, fonts and logo. Nothing is scheduled until you approve the preview.
- Smart Lead Finder (2025, Built and tested): Automated B2B lead generation across the Saudi and Jordanian markets: multi-query place search, website scraping to extract emails and WhatsApp numbers, prioritisation scoring, and duplicate-safe appends into segmented sheets.
- Lesson Quality Evaluator (2026, Built and tested): A webhook service that transcribes lesson videos with speaker separation and returns structured JSON scoring teacher quality and student engagement.
- AI Email Campaigns (2026, Built and tested): Fill in a form with a contact list and, for a job search, your CV. Each contact gets an email written for them, sent one at a time through Gmail with a random pause, and you get a report when it is done.
- CRM Lead Cleaner (2026, Built and tested): Incoming CRM leads arrive scattered — duplicates, malformed emails, missing fields — and cost sales teams hours of manual triage. This pipeline cleans them automatically and reports on what it did.

## Websites built for clients

- [Aya Rady](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/aya-rady/) — Personal branding strategist for experts and consultants. Inside-Out, the name of her programme, drawn as rings: expertise at the centre, the sides she works on around it, and a wave that lights each one until it reaches your name.
- [Mohammed Alhabbarah](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/mohammed-alhabbarah/) — Head of Learning & Capability Development, Riyadh Metro. A living metro map behind every page — lines that draw themselves, stations that breathe, small trains on the move — taken from his work on Riyadh Metro and his banner line, from the field to impact.
- [Layal Joumaa](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/layal-joumaa/) — CV writer, LinkedIn optimisation and personal branding. A living marble background in WebGL behind a CV that rewrites itself in the hero — her craft, shown instead of described.
- [Salam Aksimi](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/salam-aksimi/) — Personal branding and content on LinkedIn. Threads and sparks: the sparkle she signs every post with becomes a drawn spark, travelling along threads that connect people and ideas.
- [Tawheed Malkat](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/) — Product designer (UI/UX). The portfolio as an open design file: a dotted canvas, her name as a selected text layer, and a camera that flies through her projects as you scroll.
- Monther Al-Ashqar — Senior project manager and owner's representative. An engineering-grade portfolio on a dark blueprint, leading with the scale of a career spent on site.
- [Gambit Tournaments](https://gambit.nouraldeentofi.com/) — Tournaments platform for a chess club in Dammam. The club's black and gold, built as a full product: upcoming tournaments with live seats, guest registration, and an archive of past tournaments.
- [Prestige VIP Tailor](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/prestige-vip-tailor/) — Men's tailor, Al Khobar. From the tailor's world: pattern paper in the background, a fabric swatch book in 3D, and a thobe on a hanger that changes as the customer chooses.
- [Al-Reem Grilled Lamb](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/alreem-mashwi/) — Charcoal-grilled lamb, Al Khobar. An app on the phone: a bottom bar, an order in steps, and the shop's own photos doing the selling.
- [Portfolio Gallery](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/portfolio-gallery/) — 120 portfolio designs. Personas, scroll stories, interactive machines and whole worlds — a city builder, a solar system, a museum, a stock exchange — each one a single hand-crafted HTML file.
